check.title: Awful experience, felt like I was being scammed
check.text:
Most of the reviews seemed positive, so I bought this. Mistake.

Problems started when I plugged it in. The instructions say there's an executable on the hard drive that I need to run to install the drivers and backup software. But nope, there was no executable on the drive, it was just totally empty. Worked fine, but totally empty. I have to assume that those of you who liked the product were able to find the executable, but it wasn't there on mine. Note: I did not buy this refurbed, or any other "pre-owned" excuses.

So I went to their website, typed at the chatbot, and eventually a human came along, who had me install some sort of spyware on my computer, which trashed all of my running programs, and eventually after he poked around at everything on the computer for about 10 minutes he said there was "a problem with your printer driver, you need to have us fix it" so the external disk would work. Also that I would need to pay a "service charge" for the privilege. Umm... and explain to me, why does an external disk need a "printer driver"? I don't even have a printer.

The exchange already sounded way too much like one of those "you need to let us fix your computer because you have a virus" scams where they install ransomware and keyloggers, but when he said I'd have to pay an additional service charge just so they could make their $120 product work, I said NO! and kicked him off the computer and returned the product. BTW: kudos to Amazon for making that totally easy.

They used to be good, but after this I'm not buying anything else from Western Digital.

check.title: Upgraded from Kindle gen1
check.text:
This Kindle is definitely more capable than 1st generation.

Likes: Convenient software features like keyboard splitting and swype. Calendar works great too. GREAT audio.

Dislikes: Readjusting to another weird user interface, which in my opinion is worse than the 1st generation. Why are the favorites so much harder to get to and why is it so glitchy/slow to respond when i tap the star?

Issues: Volume down button was defective (since this is unique to me I normally wouldn't include this, but this is not my first experience with a defective kindle... amazon is nice about exchanging but it's honestly annoying). Finally, there are intermittent dead spots in the touch screen, which I also assume to be unique to me. I will deal with this as much as I can, but will exchange if it annoys me too much.
